# L.K. Plumbing & Heating

L.K. Plumbing & Heating is a family-owned plumbing company in Valley Village, California, serving the greater Los Angeles area since 1975.
We are California licensed and insured under license #307295.
We do residential and commercial plumbing, from small repairs to new construction.
Our work covers repiping, sewer and drain cleaning with hydro-jetting and video inspection, water heater installation and repair, leak detection, gas lines and earthquake shut-off valves, fixtures and fittings, and plumbing for kitchen and bathroom remodels.
We guarantee our workmanship on every job.
We accept check, cash, Visa, and Mastercard.
We work in Valley Village, across the San Fernando Valley, and in the greater Los Angeles area.
Address: 12442 La Maida St., Valley Village, CA 91607.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Phone: (323) 653-5085.
Email: info@lkplumbing.com.
Website: https://lkplumbing.com/
